event_summary: A light gray round object moves in from the left, contacts a small cluster on the tabletop, and the orange sphere moves rightward out of view while the gray and brown objects remain near the middle-right area.
raw_event_description: The scene begins with a light wood tabletop in front of a yellow couch. A brown round object and an orange sphere sit next to each other near the upper-right portion of the tabletop, while a black cylindrical object is partly visible at the left edge. After a period with the brown and orange objects still, a light gray round object enters from the left and moves rightward across the tabletop. It reaches the brown and orange objects, after which the orange sphere separates and travels to the right, eventually leaving the image at the right side. The gray object and brown object remain close together near the middle-right portion of the table with little or no visible later movement.

reasons: The tabletop and the initially present orange and brown objects are visible.

The left-edge black cylindrical object is only partly visible.
